title: German perforated metal found at Roswell

tellings.quote: a kind of perforated metal which later was discovered uh at Roswell

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani, on Jesse Michels's podcast, says German engineers of the 1940s developed a kind of perforated metal, meaning metal full of tiny holes. He says this same material was later found at Roswell, New Mexico, the site of a famous 1947 crash that some say was an alien craft. He points to Philip J. Corso, a US Army officer who wrote about Roswell, and if true the claim would tie the Roswell wreckage to German technology.
